$comment: The gift edit's authored rules: who it is for, the occasion, the budget chips, and the categories that make a good gift for each, each with the one line said about it. backend/edits.py turns these into a ranked short list per (recipient, occasion, budget) from the catalog, written to backend/data/edits.json, which both the brain and the /gifts page read. Nothing here is a product fact: a pick's other words are the catalog's own.

angles.vases: A vase is useful from the first bunch of flowers
angles.artificial-flora: Faux stems never need watering, so they suit a busy home
angles.throw-pillows: A cushion is the quickest way to make a sofa feel like theirs
angles.household-storage-baskets: A basket gives the first clutter somewhere to go
angles.candle-holders: A candle holder is a small gift for slow evenings
angles.serveware: Something to bring to the table the next time they have people round
angles.picture-frames: A frame asks for a photo, so it is a personal gift without trying
angles.food-storage: Kitchen storage is the thing nobody buys for themselves
angles.bath-towels-washcloths: Good towels are a treat people rarely buy themselves
angles.table-lamps: A lamp changes how a room feels in the evening
angles.dinnerware: Plates they will use every day
angles.cookware: A pan they will cook with for years
angles.clocks: A clock is a gift that is seen every day
